title: Reconnecting with an Old Friend
paragraphs: Setelah kehilangan kontak selama hampir lima tahun akibat kesalahpahaman kecil yang tidak sepenuhnya diingat keduanya, Tariq tanpa sengaja bertemu teman lamanya, Bassam, di pernikahan kenalan bersama. Percakapan awal terasa sedikit canggung, keduanya tidak yakin apakah harus membahas langsung tahun-tahun kesunyian itu atau sekadar melanjutkan seolah tidak terjadi apa-apa yang tidak biasa di antara mereka.

Akhirnya, Tariq menyebutkan dengan jujur bahwa ia merindukan persahabatan mereka, dan Bassam mengakui merasakan hal yang sama tapi tidak pernah tahu cara menghubungi setelah waktu yang begitu lama berlalu. Mereka bertukar nomor lagi malam itu, dan dalam sebulan, persahabatan mereka pulih hampir secara alami, mengajarkan keduanya bahwa gengsi telah merenggut tahun-tahun yang tidak akan pernah bisa mereka dapatkan kembali.
answerKey: After losing touch for nearly five years following a small misunderstanding neither of them fully remembered, Tariq unexpectedly ran into his old friend Bassam at a mutual acquaintance's wedding. The initial conversation felt slightly awkward, both of them unsure whether to address the years of silence directly or simply continue as though nothing unusual had happened between them. Eventually, Tariq mentioned honestly that he had missed their friendship, and Bassam admitted he had felt the same but never knew how to reach out after so much time had passed. They exchanged numbers again that evening, and within a month, their friendship had resumed almost naturally, teaching both of them that pride had cost them years they could never get back.
